name: TherapyNotes vs TheraNest
title: TherapyNotes vs TheraNest: Mental Health EHR Comparison 2026
description: Compare TherapyNotes and TheraNest - two popular EHR platforms for therapists. See pricing, features, telehealth, and billing differences to choose the best mental health software.

summary.bottom_line: TherapyNotes offers 24/7 support, clinician-designed templates, and lower per-claim fees, making it ideal for established practices. TheraNest has lower entry-level pricing starting at $29/month and is better for budget-conscious solo therapists just getting started.

key_differences.claims_pricing: TherapyNotes ($0.14) vs TheraNest (30 free, then varies)

sections.heading: TherapyNotes vs TheraNest: Overview
sections.content: TherapyNotes and TheraNest are both popular practice management platforms designed specifically for mental health professionals. TherapyNotes, founded in 2010 by a clinical psychologist and web developer, is known for its clinician-designed templates and exceptional 24/7 support. TheraNest, now part of Ensora Health (formerly Therapy Brands), serves over 200,000 providers and offers more flexible per-therapist pricing with lower entry-level costs.

sections.heading: Pricing Comparison
sections.content: TheraNest has lower entry-level pricing at $29/therapist/month for basic features, making it attractive for budget-conscious solo therapists. TherapyNotes starts at $69/month but includes more features at the base tier. For group practices, TherapyNotes charges $79/month plus $50 per additional clinician, while TheraNest uses per-therapist pricing at each tier level. Insurance billing costs differ significantly: TherapyNotes charges $0.14 per claim, while TheraNest includes 30 free claims monthly on Advanced plans and unlimited on Premier.

sections.heading: Feature Differences
sections.content: TherapyNotes is known for interactive note templates built by clinicians specifically for behavioral health documentation. Both platforms offer AI-powered documentation assistance at similar price points ($35-40/month). TheraNest uniquely integrates with the Wiley Treatment Planner, which may benefit clinicians who use that resource. Telehealth is included in TherapyNotes' basic plan (standard definition), while TheraNest requires the $89/month Premier plan for integrated telehealth.

sections.heading: Customer Support
sections.content: TherapyNotes differentiates with 24/7 phone and email support on all plans - a rarity in the industry. They also offer free data import from other EMRs and unlimited training resources. TheraNest provides business hours support, which may be sufficient for many practices but is a notable difference for those who need after-hours assistance.

sections.heading: Which Should You Choose?
sections.content: Choose based on your budget and support needs:

recommendations.when: You value 24/7 support, clinician-designed note templates, and are willing to pay slightly more for a comprehensive feature set
You're a budget-conscious solo therapist or startup practice looking for the lowest entry-level pricing with room to grow
You have high claims volume and want predictable per-claim pricing ($0.14/claim)
You use the Wiley Treatment Planner and want integrated treatment planning tools

faqs.q: Which is cheaper: TherapyNotes or TheraNest?
faqs.a: TheraNest has lower entry-level pricing starting at $29/month (Essentials) compared to TherapyNotes at $69/month. However, TheraNest's full-featured Premier plan costs $89/month. The best value depends on which features you need and your claims volume.

faqs.q: Does TherapyNotes or TheraNest have better telehealth?
faqs.a: TherapyNotes includes basic telehealth free on all plans (standard definition video for 2 participants), with Premium Telehealth ($15/month) adding HD and screen sharing. TheraNest only includes telehealth on the Premier plan ($89/month), making TherapyNotes better for telehealth value.
TherapyNotes offers 24/7 phone and email support on all plans, while TheraNest provides business hours support only. TherapyNotes is the clear winner for customer support availability.

faqs.q: Can I switch from TheraNest to TherapyNotes?
faqs.a: Yes, TherapyNotes offers free data import from other EMRs including TheraNest. Contact TherapyNotes support for assistance with migrating your practice data.
